system.description: You gain a rank of Mastery to Medicine. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level. Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Executioners Instrument against a creature with at least one rank of Bleed. You can force them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose the listed condition and instead they gain the Severed condition.
